title: Recruit a campus ambassador at Lakeside College
text:
We need someone like Tomas at Westbrook: a well-connected student who can run the beta testers group and post in the course group chats.

*   Ask Tomas if he knows anyone at Lakeside (he mentioned a friend in the CS club)
*   Post the role on the Lakeside student jobs board
*   Short video call with the top 2-3 candidates, Maya joins the final one
*   Offer: $15/hour, ~5 hours a week, plus Pairly swag
